method.kind: deterministic headless rules simulation, not human play or visual QA
method.route: Choose every battle/boss when offered; otherwise first branch.
method.events: First option, falling back to second if unaffordable. Camps rest, shrine takes relic, pilgrim shelters.
method.legacy: All ranks zero unless strategy starts max_legacy; those have all ranks five.
method.combat_order: Hero indices 0, 1, 2, then end round; never skip a living hero.
method.basic_focus: Free basic attack only, first intact part, no adaptive targeting.
method.break_finish: First intact part. Skill 1 while shielded if affordable; skill 2 while broken if affordable; otherwise free skill 0. No adaptation to omen or specific weakness.
method.random: Uniformly random intact target and affordable skill including Defend, separate RNG seeded by campaign seed.
method.basic_spread: Free skill 0, intact target indexed by hero_index modulo count.
method.rewards: heal = Mend the oath at every reward; tribute = Take the tribute at every reward.
method.average_final_hp: Sum of all three hero HP at victory/defeat, divided by number of runs; includes final reward healing.
method.average_rounds: Mean last round_number among won battles only; losses excluded from this metric.

limitations: Only these deterministic policies and 100 seeds tested; not a human difficulty or retention study.
All final HP values include the last chosen reward; full HP on heal routes does not mean damage was never taken.
No combat simulation models animation, input errors, save failures, screen readability, audio, or runtime performance.
The Button/Space focus concern was not reproduced and is excluded as a bug.
product_reading: Recovery rewards drive outcomes much more strongly than targeting skill for the tested routes; even random legal combat won all 100 seeds when always healing.
All three bosses share the same three moves with tier-scaled stats and changed weaknesses; no unique encounter mechanic.
Gold has only camp/event sinks and does not persist; the tested competent healing route ends with about 189 unused gold on average.
Late tribute gold and duplicate relic conversion are not clearly forecast in current reward cards; relic identities/effects are absent from battle UI.
model_sha256_scope: Committed checkpoint-7 baseline before the checkpoint-8 fixes.
